methodology_notes: overall.* comes from get_performance_overview — a page/device-level aggregate, NOT restricted by the query dimension, so it is the ground-truth total for this date range.

clusters.* comes from a query,device dimension pull (769 rows). GSC anonymizes/drops very low-volume individual queries from query-dimension results for privacy, so cluster totals UNDERCOUNT the true total (cluster sum: 24 clicks / 7,046 impressions vs the ground-truth 110 clicks / 10,832 impressions from overall.*). This is a known, documented GSC API behavior, not a bug in this pull. Cluster figures are still valid for RELATIVE comparison across snapshots taken with the same methodology — do not read them as complete totals.

uae_mobile.* comes from a country=are,device dimension pull — page/device-level, NOT query-restricted, so this IS a ground-truth figure (unlike clusters.uae_mobile_query_sample below, which is provided only for cross-checking and inherits the query-dimension undercount).

products_indexed is a proxy count (distinct /products/{slug}/ pages showing >0 impressions in the page-dimension pull) rather than a formal GSC Coverage index status, to avoid burning URL Inspection API quota (10 URLs/batch, rate-limited) on a routine snapshot. Re-verify via URL Inspection at a real checkpoint (d30, d60, d90) if this proxy and Coverage disagree.
